name: Ashen Crownblade
flavorText: A fallen champion whose blade still burns.
designDescription: Frontline duelist with a broad ember-edged sword, scorched ivory armor, and a crown-shaped voxel helm.

name: Mireglass Stalker
flavorText: It follows the ripples left by fear.
designDescription: Lean amphibious predator with translucent teal plates, long foreclaws, and a low silhouette built for fast flanking.

name: Hollowroot Oracle
designDescription: A robed root-seer with a hollow timber mask, suspended seed-lights, and a staff grown from a single pale branch.

name: Bastion of the First Mountain
flavorText: The valley grew around its patience.
designDescription: A towering square-shouldered stone sentinel with layered cliff armor, mineral seams, and a tiny glowing core.

name: Argent Nightlancer
flavorText: One precise strike can end a long war.
designDescription: A disciplined general in silver-black lamellar armor, carrying a long narrow lance and a banner clasp shaped like a crescent.

name: Cinder-Maw
flavorText: The furnace inside it never learned restraint.
designDescription: A furnace-backed demon hound with split obsidian jaws, molten ribs, and short heavy limbs that leave ember marks.

name: Wyrm of the Drowned Vault
flavorText: Its hoard is measured in sunken centuries.
designDescription: A long deep-sea dragon with pearl-blue scale blocks, a crown of broken ship bells, and fins like torn sails.

name: Verdant Colossus
flavorText: A forest stands wherever it kneels.
designDescription: A hulking walking grove of dark bark, mossy stone, thick root legs, and a crown of square-cut branches.

name: Ironwrought Hound
flavorText: Its nose detects weakness in steel and flesh.
designDescription: A compact articulated steel hound with exposed piston joints, a wedge-shaped muzzle, and a single amber sensor.

name: Dustveil Matriarch
flavorText: Her tracks vanish before the dust settles.
designDescription: A broad desert beetle-lion with sandstone plates, layered mandibles, and a mantle of drifting mineral dust.

name: Lantern of the Lost Choir
flavorText: A small light that recalls forgotten names.
designDescription: A floating blue-glass lantern wrapped in ribbon-like water and tiny mask fragments that orbit its core.

name: The Star-Eater
flavorText: At the edge of night, even constellations fall silent.
designDescription: A vast angular void-being with a floating eclipse core, disconnected voxel rings, and a silhouette that bends inward.

name: Tidemark Astrologer
flavorText: She charts the future in the gaps between falling stars.
designDescription: A masked sky-reader carrying a rotating brass astrolabe, segmented robe panels, and a thin halo of silver markers.

name: Gilt-Ash Bargainer
flavorText: Every oath has a price; every price leaves a mark.
designDescription: A horned contract-broker with cracked gold masks, heavy stone cuffs, and parchment strips sealed into its armor.

name: Cloudbreak Coil
flavorText: Its iron whiskers split thunder before the storm arrives.
designDescription: A serpentine sky-dragon with segmented steel scales, turbine-like fins, and a forked crest shaped like lightning rods.

name: Rootbound Witness
flavorText: It has watched kingdoms rise from dust and return to it.
designDescription: An ancient monolith wrapped in thick roots, with carved stone eyes and a crown of weathered standing stones.

name: Bell of the Unmoored
flavorText: Its toll guides the lost, though none agree where they arrive.
designDescription: A floating temple bell grown through with roots, hung with small wooden charms and pale green motes.

name: The Unwritten Guest
flavorText: Every witness recalls a different shape standing in the rain.
designDescription: An uncanny figure made from suspended rain-glass shards, with a blank faceplate and a cloak that flows upward.
